name: EPIC 212023103
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 7.1 solar radii and 1.08 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212023103 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.059886 (16th-84th percentiles 6.816454-7.31451), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212023103 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.084768 (16th-84th percentiles 0.996916-1.181085), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212023103: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4853.4473 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212023103 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3825.117188 (16th-84th percentiles 3720.625-3933.125), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.04 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,825 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.08 solar masses and 7.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,853 K at its surface.
